name: mcg-qlik-demo
description: Meridian Commerce Group — Qlik Cloud end-to-end demo environment

scripts.data:qvd: node deploy/mockdata/gen-lakehouse-csv.js && node deploy/mockdata/upload-lakehouse-csv.js && node deploy/mockdata/repoint-load-scripts.js qvd
scripts.db:schema: node deploy/compose.js exec -i mcg-postgres psql -U mcg_admin -d mcg_wms -f /dev/stdin < simulators/schema.sql
scripts.db:seed: node deploy/compose.js exec mcg-seed-data python seed_data.py --postgres --pg-host postgres --pg-db mcg_wms --pg-user mcg_admin --pg-pass mcg_demo_2025 --mysql --my-host mysql --my-port 3306 --my-db mcg_crm --my-user root --my-pass mcg_root_2025
scripts.lint: node -c deploy/deploy-to-qlik.js && node -c deploy/deploy-ui.js && node -c deploy/zip-utils.js && node -c deploy/container-engine.js && node -c deploy/compose.js && node -c deploy/build-apps.js && node -c deploy/build-automations.js && node -c deploy/build-pipeline-zip.js && node -c deploy/build-talend-zip.js && node -c deploy/stewardship.js && node -c deploy/automation-workspaces.js && node -c generators/capture-tenant-screenshots.js && node -c generators/lib/deck-media.js && node -c deploy/pull-connection-template.js && node -c deploy/marketecture-column-swap.js && node -c deploy/pipelines/setup-vscode-template.js && node -c generators/gen-ceo-video-review.js
